findings.message: bug-proposal: a second, unused module-level literal resolving the operator's machine-level telemetry directory survives outside container.telemetry_state_dir(), the seam this commit introduces as "the ONE resolver"
findings.detail_md: `dadaia_workspace/features/telemetry/service.py` line 49 still declares `_DEFAULT_STATE_DIR = pathlib.Path("~/.dadaia/state/telemetry").expanduser()`, a module-level constant evaluated at import time (before any per-test HOME redirect or monkeypatch fixture can run), and line 155 uses it as the default value of `TelemetryService.__init__`'s `state_dir` parameter. This is a second literal resolution of the exact path `container.telemetry_state_dir()` now claims sole ownership of. Reproduction: `grep -n 'expanduser' dadaia_workspace/features/telemetry/service.py` shows the literal; `grep -rn 'TelemetryService(' dadaia_workspace tests` shows every current call site (dadaia_workspace/cli/commands/panel_composition.py:90 in production; six test files) passes `state_dir=` explicitly, so the default is presently unreachable and this commit's fix is not currently defeated. But the module was not touched by this commit (last touched 0fee8cdd, prior release), so the duplicate predates T-047-26's diagnosis and was not swept up by it. Any future caller that omits `state_dir=` -- a new test, a new CLI wiring path -- silently resurrects exactly the defect this commit fixes: synthetic writes into the operator's real machine store. Ruled out as agent error/wrong usage/environment limit: this is a contract violation of the fix's own stated invariant ("the ONE resolver"), reproducible by inspection alone, not a designed validation.
findings.fix_recommendation: Operator-confirmed bug proposal, not yet registered (no operator present in this review session, per dd-bug-registration). If confirmed: `dadaia bugs append --bug-id telemetry-service-default-state-dir-duplicate-home-literal --reported-by security-reviewer --title "TelemetryService.__init__ default state_dir re-resolves the operator home path outside the one telemetry_state_dir() seam" --severity MEDIUM --surface dadaia_workspace/features/telemetry/service.py --component telemetry --context dadaia-workspace --symptom "a second Path.home()-based literal survives as an unused constructor default after T-047-26 introduced container.telemetry_state_dir() as the one resolver" --repro "grep -n expanduser dadaia_workspace/features/telemetry/service.py; grep -n state_dir dadaia_workspace/features/telemetry/service.py" --expected "TelemetryService.__init__ has no home-resolving default; state_dir is either required or defaulted via container.telemetry_state_dir() called at construction time". Fix (structural, not this reviewer's to write): delete `_DEFAULT_STATE_DIR` and make `state_dir` a required keyword argument, or default it to `None` and resolve via `container.telemetry_state_dir()` inside `__init__` so there is truly one resolver, matching this commit's own claim.
